target: Beijing default development and staging host

outcome.uplinkDnsReachability: no response from either configured Alibaba Cloud resolver

evidence: The same Provider hostname resolved from the local control host but not from Beijing.
Beijing Node lookup and system resolver lookup failed for the Provider hostname; a common control hostname also timed out.
The resolver had two Alibaba Cloud uplink DNS addresses configured, while both showed no ICMP response during the bounded read-only check.
Resolver logs repeatedly alternated degraded UDP and TCP feature sets, consistent with an unavailable upstream path.

nextGate.requestedAuthority: Restart systemd-resolved exactly once on the Beijing host, then perform read-only resolution and service-health checks.
